 The Police-Inspector of Basavanagudi south Women P.S. has filed chargesheet against Accused no.1 to 3 for the offences punishable U/s.498A, 506 r/w/s 34 of IPC  2.
The criminal law has been set into motion based on the first information statement of Dr. SEEMA MALICK..

The gist of the prosecution case is that the Accused No-1 got married to Cw-1 on 01-08-2014 at Ameen Masjid and after the marriage accused and CW1 started residing at No.172, 5th cross, J.H.B.C.S.Layout, BSK 2nd stage, Bangalore and while staying, accused No.1 was not going to job telling loss of business and had affairs with other ladies and used to chat, coming home late, when questioned by CW-1, accused picked up quarrel saying "Its his wish to stay as it  3  C.C.No.20231/2019 is her second marriage etc.." That the Accused No.2 and 3 demanded CW-1 give money for his business other wise accused would marry another woman .
CW-1 paid cash of Rs.1,00,000/- to accused by pledging her gold ornaments.

CW-1 begot a female child to which, accused No.1 to 3 demanded a male child, abused her and did not provide food to her and used to harass her by telling he will marry another women and asked her to leave the matrimonial home and Accused No.2 and 3 were supporting the same.

sentences.text: In order to prove the charges, the prosecution has examined PW-1 and got marked Ex.P.1 and P.2 documents.
As there were no any incriminating circumstances in the evidence against the accused, the statement of accused as required U/s.313 of Cr.P.C., is dispensed with.
6. Heard arguments on both the sides.
I have Perused the materials on record.

7. The following points arise for my determination:-
 5  C.C.No.20231/2019  1) Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable  doubt that the accused persons caused physical and  mental cruelty to the complainant in demand of dowry  and threatened her and thereby accused have committed  the offences punishable U/s.498A, 506 r/w/s 34 of IPC. ?
 2) what order?
 8.

My finding to the above points are as under:-
 Point No.1 ........In the Negative.
 Point No.2........

As per final order, for the following:-
 REASONS  9.
POINT No.1 :- It is the fundamental principle of criminal jurisprudence that the prosecution has to prove its case beyond reasonable doubt.

In order to bring home the guilt of the accused,
the prosecution has examined one witness as PW-1 and got marked Ex.P.1 and Ex.P2 documents.
Ex.P1 is the first information statement.
Ex.P.2 is the spot panchanama.
10. CW-1 was examined as PW-1 Dr.Seema Malick.

sentences.text: her examination-in-chief has deposed that her marriage with accused No.1 was performed on 01-08-2014 and deposed after the marriage, accused looked after her well and deposed accused did not subjected her to any physical and mental cruelty, in demand of  6  C.C.No.20231/2019 dowry and never abused, assaulted her and threatened to kill her.
PW-1 deposed that there was petty quarrel between her and accused in respect to family issues, for which she went to the police station.
There the police have took her signatures on documents.
PW-1 identified Ex.P.1 first information statement and also identified her signature at Ex.P1.
PW-1 also identified Ex.P.2 spot Panchanama and her signature at Ex.P2 and she pleaded her ignorance about the contents of Ex.P.1 and P.2.
The learned Sr.APP treated PW-1 as hostile witness and cross examined her.
During which PW-1 admitted that she and accused have compromised the matter and denied all other suggestions.
11. On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is apparent that PW-1 being the informant, key and material witness have turned hostile to the prosecution case.
Therefore, this court was pleased to reject the prayer of the learned Sr.APP to summon other chargesheeted witnesses.

Even, if the summons was issued to other chargesheeted witnesses, no purpose would be served as the material witness has given go-bye to her own statement and also the valuable time of the court would be saved.

As such other charge sheeted witnesses were dropped and prosecution evidence was  7 Seema Malika vs Nadima Khan on 5 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/108174532/
5  C.C.No.20231/2019 taken as closed.

In view of the material witness, turning hostile,
and in the absence of evidence of material witness, the prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the accused beyond reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.
12. POINT No.2:-

For the foregoing reasons, I proceed to pass the following:
 ORDER
In exercise of power conferred Under Section 248(1) of Cr.P.C., Accused No.1 to 3 are acquitted of the offences punishable U/s. 498A, 506 r/w/s 34 of IPC.
The bail bonds of accused No.1 to 3 shall be in force for a period of 6 months.
